text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 2: Each arm's mean absolute error minus ERA5's, and each row set's planned contrasts'
text.tspan: Figure 2: Each arm's mean absolute error minus ERA5's, and each row

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Top panel of each block: each arm's mean absolute error minus the reference arm's. Lower panel: that row set's planned contrasts, the first arm's error minus the second's; each row names both arms. Compare arms only within a block: each block is scored on its own rows, so an error in one block is not comparable with an error in another. The station rows rest on one nearby weather station per farm, and cover fewer months than the other blocks. Main: 16.4% of scored rows are in a calendar month, seen in two or more years, with no training row in their fold, and 0.0% are in a calendar month seen in one year only, which no fold design can cover. ICON-DREAM-EU: 25.1% of scored rows are in a calendar month, seen in two or more years, with no training row in their fold, and 0.0% are in a calendar month seen in one year only, which no fold design can cover; covering those months moves its two planned contrasts by +0.009 and -0.028 points at the primary setting, with no change of sign or of statistical significance; absolute errors under covering folds are expected to be slightly lower, by analogy with the past-solar study; not measured for this block. ECMWF: 0.0% of scored rows are in a calendar month, seen in two or more years, with no training row in their fold, and 9.4% are in a calendar month seen in one year only, which no fold design can cover. Station: 0.0% of scored rows are in a calendar month, seen in two or more years, with no training row in their fold, and 42.2% are in a calendar month seen in one year only, which no fold design can cover. Wind heights of each block's arms: Main: 100 m; ICON 80 m. ICON-DREAM-EU: 100 m; ICON 80 m; ICON-DREAM-EU 96 m. ECMWF: 100 m; ICON 80 m. Station: 10 m station and ERA5 arm; 100 m others. ICON-DREAM-EU: planned contrasts were written after the main block's five products were scored. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output. Three wind farms in Lincolnshire. Every block's contrasts are against ERA5, scored on that block's own rows, except the station block's, which are against ERA5's 10 m wind. Hollow triangle: the same contrast at the second hyperparameter setting, shown for planned contrasts and for contrasts near the 5% line. Planned: one of the comparisons written into the study plan before any result existed. Every other row is exploratory or, where marked, post hoc.'
